title: How to dynamically update searchParameters?

comments.body:
It works, by adding this additional widget! Thanks a lot!

Is there a way to reset a setting? Like to remove `restrictSearchableAttributes` afterwards?  `delete options.helper.restrictSearchableAttribute;` does not work.

Can you try options.helper.setQueryParameter('restrictableSearchableAttributes');

Just passing no value should remove it
`options.helper.setQueryParameter('restrictableSearchableAttributes')` does not work. The previous value is still set. I tried already null, false, ''. But they all raise an error from the API.
If it's really not working can you give me a reproducible website where you have the issue, or a github project, or send an email to support@algolia.com with a private url if you need to.
`options.helper.search();` did the job! Thanks for your help, @vvo! I'll come back to your offer and contact you via the support forms later this week.
